what.text: LGD-4033 (ligandrol) is a nonsteroidal, oral selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). It binds the androgen receptor with high affinity and selectivity. It was later developed under the code VK5211.

src.label: Basaria et al., J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci, 2013
J Bone Miner Metab, 2023 (ligandrol, also VK5211)

what.text: It is not an approved medicine. Products labelled as containing it are sold online, often as “research use only.” FDA considers such SARM products unapproved drugs.

what.text: LGD-4033 is not FDA approved for any use. It is banned in sport at all times.

research.text: Two human trials have been reported: a 3-week Phase 1 study in 76 healthy young men, and a 12-week Phase 2 trial in older adults after hip fracture. Neither tested it for low testosterone.

research.title: Safety and drug levels in healthy young men (Basaria et al.)

facts.v: placebo or 0.1, 0.3 or 1.0 mg a day
safety, drug levels, lean and fat mass, strength, stair-climb power, hormones, lipids, PSA

research.found: Lean body mass rose with dose; fat mass did not change. Total testosterone, SHBG, HDL cholesterol and triglycerides fell with dose. FSH and free testosterone fell at the 1.0 mg dose. Hormones and lipids returned to baseline after stopping. No drug-related serious adverse events; liver enzymes and PSA did not change.

facts.v: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II trial; sponsor Viking Therapeutics
108 men and women aged 65 and over recovering from hip fracture
change in lean body mass (excluding head) by DXA scan

research.found: In the registry results, placebo-corrected lean mass rose 4.75%, 7.15% and 9.08% in the three dose groups (79 people analyzed). Serious adverse events occurred in 4 of 28 on placebo and 2 to 5 per dose group. The search found no peer-reviewed paper of the full results.

research.text: In rats with their ovaries removed, ligandrol was studied for bone. In healthy male rats given ligandrol for 8 weeks, endurance, testosterone and FSH fell, and triglycerides and cholesterol rose. These results are in animals only.

us.text: LGD-4033 is not FDA approved for any use. Products labelled “research use only” are unapproved drugs, and FDA does not allow them to be sold for people to take. As of November 1, 2026.

items.text: FDA says that although SARMs are often marketed as dietary supplements or “sold for research use only,” they are considered unapproved drugs, and SARMs cannot be legally marketed in the US as a dietary supplement or a drug at this time. FDA also notes that products labelled “for research purposes” or “not for human consumption” have been sold directly to consumers for human use. FDA does not allow these products to be sold for people to take.

after.text: The WADA 2026 Prohibited List names LGD-4033 (ligandrol) under S1.2 Other anabolic agents, in the class of selective androgen receptor modulators (SARMs). S1 substances are prohibited at all times, in and out of competition. The 2027 list keeps the same S1.2 wording.

side.text: In the Phase 1 trial, LGD-4033 lowered the body’s own testosterone, SHBG and HDL (“good”) cholesterol in 3 weeks. Case reports describe severe liver injury in people who used products sold as ligandrol.

items.text: total testosterone, SHBG, HDL cholesterol and triglycerides fell with dose; FSH and free testosterone fell at 1.0 mg. Levels returned to baseline after stopping.

items.text: a 32-year-old man developed severe liver injury after using ligandrol; a liver biopsy showed cholestatic hepatitis with mild fibrosis. Another man developed liver injury after products containing RAD-140 and LGD-4033.

items.text: FDA lists serious or life-threatening problems linked to SARMs in studies and reports: higher risk of heart attack or stroke, psychosis and hallucinations, sleep problems, sexual dysfunction, liver injury and acute liver failure, infertility, miscarriage and testicular shrinkage. FDA says liver injuries needing hospital care have occurred.

items.text: Health Canada links SARMs to drug-induced liver damage, heart attack and stroke, changes in blood lipids, fluid retention, thicker blood, and hormone disruption that can lead to infertility, lower sex drive, sexual dysfunction and breast enlargement in men.

items.text: SARMs act on the androgen receptor. Like testosterone, they can lower the body’s own testosterone and the hormones that drive sperm production. FDA and Health Canada both list infertility among the risks.
